name: "Aionsoft Tailwind CSS"
description: "Use when styling Svelte components, editing app CSS, changing themes, or composing responsive layouts with Tailwind CSS."
applyTo: "apps/**/*.{svelte,css}"
---

# Tailwind CSS Profile

- Use the owning app's Tailwind version, theme tokens, and established utility patterns.
- Prefer semantic color tokens over raw palette values for reusable application UI.
- Keep global CSS focused on tokens, base styles, and genuinely shared behavior.
- Preserve responsive behavior and verify layouts at mobile and desktop widths.
- Reuse shared UI primitives before duplicating component-level styling.
